N.-W. F. P. STATUTES
ACT VII OF 1992
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE GOVERNMENT SERVANTS
BENEVOLENT FUND (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to amend the
North-West Frontier Province Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance,
1972
[Gazette of N: W.F.P., Extraordinary, 27th September, 1992]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis/92/19450-51,
dated 27-9-1992: -The North-West Frontier Province Government Servants
Benevolent Fund (Amendment) Bill, 1992, having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province on the 8th September, 1992 and
assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on the 23rd
September, 1992 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of
North-West Frontier Province.
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the
North-West Frontier Province Government Servants Benevolent Fund (Amendment)
Act, 1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Government Servants Benevolent Fund Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Amendment of section 4 of N. W.F.P. Ordinance No.VII of 1972

N
N.-W. F. P. STATUTES
ACT VII OF 1992
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE GOVERNMENT SERVANTS
BENEVOLENT FUND (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to amend the
North-West Frontier Province Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance,
1972
[Gazette of N: W.F.P., Extraordinary, 27th September, 1992]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis/92/19450-51,
dated 27-9-1992: -The North-West Frontier Province Government Servants
Benevolent Fund (Amendment) Bill, 1992, having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province on the 8th September, 1992 and
assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on the 23rd
September, 1992 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of
North-West Frontier Province.
2. Amendment of section 4 of N. W.F.P. Ordinance No.VII of 1972. In
the North-West Frontier Province Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance,
1972 the existing section 4 shall be numbered as subsection (1) of section 4,
and after subsection (1) as so renumbered, the following new subsection shall
be added, namely:
"(2)
Notwithstanding the provisions contained in subsection (1) Government may make
such schemes as it considers necessary for the welfare of Government servants
or their families and utilize the Fund to implement such schemes in such manner
and subject to such conditions as may be prescribed."
